load_urdf_robot: load a URDF robot model like r2d2.urdf into a PyBullet physics simulation
connect_pybullet_client: connect to a PyBullet physics server in GUI, DIRECT, or SHARED_MEMORY mode
initialize_urdf_editor_from_body: initialize a UrdfEditor instance from an existing PyBullet body object
save_urdf_to_file: save a UrdfEditor representation to a URDF file on disk
create_multibody_from_editor: create a multi-body object in the simulation from a UrdfEditor instance
